meta.name: ast-grep
meta.description: Searches and rewrites code by AST shape across 25 languages. Use when the target is a syntax pattern (every call/class/import shaped like X, a codemod, a YAML rule) rather than literal text; for plain strings, comments, or filenames, use rg.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按代码的语法结构搜索并批量重写代码
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要在大量文件里按语法结构统一改代码
copy.tagline_en: Search and rewrite code by its syntax structure, at scale
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to edit code by syntax pattern across many files

howto.what: Claude 能按代码的语法结构（而非文字）在 25 种语言里搜索和改写：找出所有某类函数调用、类、import，或按 YAML 规则扫描。改写默认先给预览，确认后才落盘。
howto.when: 当目标是语法结构（比如某类函数、调用或类的形状）、要做 codemod 或跑 YAML 规则时触发；若只是字符串、注释、文件名等纯文本，则改用 rg。

say.text: 用 ast-grep 找出所有接收 Request 参数的函数
跑一遍项目里的 YAML 规则，把违规处列出来
say.note: 读取 sgconfig.yml 中的规则

howto.what_en: Claude can search and rewrite code by AST shape across 25 languages — finding calls, classes or imports shaped like X, or scanning YAML rules. Rewrites default to a dry-run preview before anything is applied.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the target is a syntax shape (e.g. a kind of function, call or class), a codemod, or a YAML rule. For plain text like strings, comments or filenames, use rg instead.

say_en.text: Use ast-grep to find every function that takes a Request parameter.
Rewrite every console.log(x) to logger.info(x), don't apply yet.
Run the project's YAML rules and list the violations.
